sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def barpos():
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b':
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return min(rs),min(cs)
def check(r):
    return bool(r.get('level_completed') or r.get('run_complete') or r.get('done'))
def step(a):
    r=action([a]); 
    if r.get('game_over') or r.get('run_complete'): return 'GO'
    if check(r): return 'WIN'
    return 'ok'
def goto(tr,tc):
    while True:
        r,c=barpos()
        if (r,c)==(tr,tc): return 'ok'
        if r<tr: a='DOWN'
        elif r>tr: a='UP'
        elif c<tc: a='RIGHT'
        else: a='LEFT'
        s=step(a)
        if s!='ok': return s
print('start',barpos())
for (tr,tc) in [(16,28),(12,28),(20,28),(24,28),(28,28),(32,28),(36,28),(40,28),(44,28)]:
    s=goto(tr,tc)
    print('at',(tr,tc),'->',s, barpos())
    if s!='ok': break
print('final',barpos())
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def barpos():
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b':
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return min(rs),min(cs)
def check(r):
    return bool(r.get('level_completed') or r.get('run_complete') or r.get('done'))
def step(a):
    r=action([a]); 
    if r.get('game_over') or r.get('run_complete'): return 'GO'
    if check(r): return 'WIN'
    return 'ok'
def goto(tr,tc):
    while True:
        r,c=barpos()
        if (r,c)==(tr,tc): return 'ok'
        if r<tr: a='DOWN'
        elif r>tr: a='UP'
        elif c<tc: a='RIGHT'
        else: a='LEFT'
        s=step(a)
        if s!='ok': return s
print('start',barpos())
for (tr,tc) in [(16,28),(12,28),(20,28),(24,28),(28,28),(32,28),(36,28),(40,28),(44,28)]:
    s=goto(tr,tc)
    print('at',(tr,tc),'->',s, barpos())
    if s!='ok': break
print('final',barpos())
